study type: single-center, parallel, prospective randomized controlled trial (RCT)
cohort: 148 adult females with singleton pregnancies undergoing elective CD under spinal anesthesia (ASA I and II)
finding: While there was no significant difference in the incidence or severity of early PONV at 6 hours, the incidence of vomiting or dry retching at 24 hours after cesarean delivery was lower in the CHO group compared to standard starvation.
mod_finding: The incidence of vomiting or dry retching at 24 hours after cesarean delivery was lower in the women who had oral carbohydrate loading compared to those who had standard fasting.
